# PSI Swarm

> Distributional Lighthouse / PageSpeed audits with grounded performance analysis across the fleet.
> Formerly psi-swarm (repo slug retained as an alias).

## Product

- [Home](https://performance.sassmaker.com/): Run repeated Lighthouse audits from the local-first controller
- [Projects](https://performance.sassmaker.com/projects/): Per-project results
- [Compare](https://performance.sassmaker.com/compare/): Compare two tagged swarms across percentile results
- [Watchlist](https://performance.sassmaker.com/watchlist/): Review locally tracked performance regressions
- [Demo gallery](https://performance.sassmaker.com/gallery/): Explore static before-and-after performance examples
- [Changelog](https://performance.sassmaker.com/changelog/): Verified PSI Swarm product and release history

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://performance.sassmaker.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [OpenAPI spec](https://performance.sassmaker.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable API description
- [Homepage markdown](https://performance.sassmaker.com/index.md): Product brief without JS
- [This index](https://performance.sassmaker.com/llms.txt)

## When to use this

- Running distributional Lighthouse/PageSpeed audits across multiple device and network presets
- Comparing p50/p75/p90/p99 Web Vitals percentiles instead of single-run noise
- Tracking performance regressions across tagged swarms and project baselines
- Exploring before-and-after performance optimization examples in the demo gallery
